name: paged
description: Two pages of the assets table. The Open API pages with an explicit page number at count=500, so page one is served exactly 500 rows -- the only way to make the walk ask for a second page. Each page has its own route keyed on the page number in the query string, and the page-one route returns nothing once consumed, so a walk that never advanced would import 500 assets instead of 502 rather than looping. The rows are generated and deliberately uniform; the field mapping is covered by happy.json.
